## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and scope.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish repository checks, mocks, integration checks, and provider-side verification. State anything unverified.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe affected runtimes, consent behavior, failure handling, migrations, and limitations where relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept this change focused.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Verification matches the behavior implemented; planned SDK support is not presented as working.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or sensitive diagnostics are included.
